plan.title: UC inflamed vs control: GSVA hallmark pathway scores + heatmap
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks for a per-sample pathway activity score and a heatmap showing which hallmark pathways separate ulcerative colitis inflamed colon from control colon. The design is 6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts (12000 genes x 13 samples per profile, though metadata lists 12 samples for the 6v6 comparison — the plan treats the 12-sample condition table as authoritative for the two-group comparison). Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below median and per the QC rule must be kept, inspected, and only dropped with a stated reason, not by default. Since GSVA needs a per-sample expression matrix and its own internal statistical test is not the way to test group differences, the standard, package-grounded route is: (1) DESeq2-based sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) surfacing sample_01 and confirming/rejecting it as a QC exclusion; (2) minimal low-count filtering and DESeq2 size-factor normalization producing a variance-stabilized expression matrix; (3) GSVA (Poisson-kernel, appropriate for counts, or Gaussian-kernel on the VST matrix) computing one hallmark-pathway activity score per sample against the 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene sets staged for human; (4) limma moderated t-tests on the GSVA score matrix, using the same condition design, to identify which hallmark pathways significantly differ between UC-inflamed and control, with BH-adjusted p-values; (5) a heatmap of the GSVA score matrix (samples x hallmark pathways, annotated by condition) plus a results table and report satisfying reproducibility and reporting rules. Both deliverables the user asked for — a per-sample score and a heatmap that separates treated from control — come out of steps 3-5.

steps.method: vst(blind), PCA, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
GSVA per-sample pathway scores (Poisson kernel on counts) with limma differential test on scores vs UC-inflamed vs control
Heatmap of hallmark GSVA scores across samples, annotated by condition, plus limma results table
